## DO and DON'T with AI

- **Break up** vague tasks (big black boxes) into small, verifiable steps (tiny black boxes).
- **Document** your method, step by step, so you can show how you got there.
- **Use AI** to speed up simple tasks you could do yourself, given time.
- **Break up the data**. One prompt per piece. Failing that, number the sections and ask for a numbered, section-by-section answer.

::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {.callout-warning}
## DON'T
- Hand an AI a long text and trust it to attend to all of it. Attention is expensive; it skims and jumps to conclusions.
- Ask an AI to do maths, e.g. tallying rubric findings. Still terrible at it.
- Ask for *implicit* counting: "more positive or negative mentions of X?"
:::
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {.callout-tip}
## DO
- Synthesise the separate AI outputs by hand, explicitly (Excel?).
:::
:::

:::

# AI-led interviews??

## DO: When to use AI interviewing

- You **don't know exactly what to ask**
- Less structured, **explorative conversations**
- Respondents use **different languages**
- You want to **scale up** from H2H

## DON'T: When not to use AI interviewing

- A **questionnaire** would do
- You have **many specific questions**
- **Sensitive information** or **vulnerable populations**
- You really need the **human-to-human** contact

## Where AI interviewing fits

| Method | Quality | Quantity |
|--------|---------|----------|
| Face-to-face interviews | High | Low |
| Conversational AI interviewing | Medium-high | Medium-high |
| Structured questionnaires | Low | High |

# A case study

## A real-world case study using Qualia

**Background**

DuocUC, a higher-education institution in Chile, hired Causal Map Ltd for QuIP-style interviews with Qualia, analysed in the Causal Map app. The concern: **gender gaps for women in STEM careers** at the university.

## Step 1: Setting up the interview in Qualia

- AI interviewer briefed much like **a human interviewer**.
- Instructions and interviews both in **Spanish**.
- Questions on change across **3 domains**: education, professional development, relationships.
- Used GPT-4o, the best model at the time.

## Step 2: Collecting stories with Qualia

- Link sent to 50 people; **32 interviews** collected.
- Individual links to track each one.
- Results downloaded from Qualia, uploaded to Causal Map.

## Step 3: Analysing stories with Causal Map

- AI (GPT-4o) found **every causal link**, labelling cause and effect.
- **"Radical zero-shot"**: no codebook, AI invents its own codes (in Spanish), given project context.
- **251 causal links** found.
